info.description: Cifras REM del establecimiento junto al promedio nacional y de pares, y el avance de las Metas Sanitarias

get.summary: Every fuente this install holds: REM Serie A and P, year by year, the establishments, and FONASA's Población Inscrita Validada (piv). Each says where it comes from (origen: datos públicos DEIS, or FONASA), up to when (fecha_corte: YYYY-MM for REM, the newest corte's YYYY-MM-DD for the PIV), how many rows it holds, and whether it is whole (estado: ok, incompleto, sin datos). A REM year also says how many of its códigos no dictionary explains (sin_descripcion) and whose dictionary labels it (etiquetas_de).

get.summary: One fuente, with its catálogo. For rem-a and rem-p, one year's hojas, secciones, prestaciones (código and label) and columns (col01…col50 and label), from that year's DICCIONARIO CODIGOS or, for a year without one, from the nearest later year's (etiquetas_de). For establecimientos, the values a peer group is chosen from, each with how many establishments carry it. For piv, FONASA's cortes, newest first, each with how many establishments and inscritos it holds.

post.summary: Answers one consulta: the local establishment's series and, when the spec asks to compare, the national and the peer group's. Each is summed and grouped as the spec says, and comes with the labels of what was summed and the fuente it came from. The builder and the tableros ask through here, so the API returns the UI's numbers (a15). The metas' routes are the same specs, asked on the server for GET indicadores (docs/adr/0006 amendment).
post.description:
The spec is refused in Spanish, before any SQL, when it names anything it may not: an unknown key, a column outside col01…col50, a metric that is not suma or promedio_establecimiento (a16). A consulta that runs past 10 s is cancelled and refused the same way.
The local series is this install's establishment (app config), unless the request names another DEIS code: a parameter, not an implicit «ours» (suite ADR-0009). The app's own pages never send one, because a clinic selector is a governance decision nobody has taken. For each serie and month an establishment's planilla covers, its local series is the newest planilla's figures, a blank cell sin informar; the national and the peer series are DEIS's alone (docs/adr/0010).
It is a POST because the spec is a JSON document, and it spends the read limit because it writes nothing.

get.summary: The Metas Sanitarias of a year, month by month (a12). For each meta: this install's establishment's numerador, denominador and %, and the gaps to its meta comprometida and to the meta nacional (in points); beside them, the country's % and the peer group's, wherever the denominator is nationally computable: REM, or FONASA's inscritos when a corte serves the year and the meta's ages are whole bands. poblacion.falta_oficial marks a meta whose ages cut a band: no denominador until its denominador comprometido, which serves the local % only (docs/adr/0007). Percentages are percentages: 90 is 90 %.
get.description:
A Serie A month adds up to that month; a Serie P month is the latest corte up to it (June, December); a month past the data has no figure. A manual meta (VIII) is its typed cumplimiento. numerador and denominador are the meta's routes as its seed file writes them, with the REM dictionaries they cite (docs/adr/0008).
The local series is this install's establishment (app config, suite ADR-0009). fecha_corte_local is its own last month with a written number in each serie (YYYY-MM by fuente id; null without an establishment): a Serie A month past it has no local figure, while the country's and the peers' end at the fuente's fecha de corte. The peers are the register's establishments that share the chosen traits with it; aviso says why there are none when some were asked for.
ponytail: the list is the one route. A route per meta joins when a consumer needs one alone.

parameters.name: anio
parameters.description: the metas' year; the newest with metas up to the current year when omitted

parameters.name: pares
parameters.description: what the peers share with this establishment, comma-separated: tipo, dependencia, nivel, servicio, region or comuna; empty for no peers

get.summary: The Resumen (docs/adr/0009): one card per meta of the newest metas, for the establishment. Each card is the meta's last month with a figure (mes, YYYY-MM): its numerador, denominador and %, the same as GET indicadores' local series for that month, and whether it cumple against its meta comprometida when one is typed, else the meta nacional. A manual meta (VIII) is its cumplimiento informado, with no mes. A month with no written number in any of the meta's cells has no figure, never 0. datos_al (YYYY-MM) is the establishment's own last month in the meta's serie, the fecha_corte_local GET indicadores serves for its fuente: a Serie P mes shows its latest corte, so the two can differ. None for a manual meta. estado says why a meta shows none: «esperando ruta oficial» while its seed marks a ruta "oficial": false, or «falta el denominador oficial de <año>» while its ages cut a PIV band and no denominador comprometido is typed. Only the establishment's own figures are asked: no country, no peers.
get.description:
The card's year is the latest with REM figures, never past the metas' own: next year's metas, loaded in October, are counted over this year. historico is the meta over each year of the ventana up to that one, oldest first, its periodos moved by whole years: each month's mes, numerador, denominador and % (Serie P at its June and December cortes, each its own: a corte not reported is null, never the one before), and cierre, December's %, once the year is over. estado is «sin datos comparables» for a year whose own diccionario labels a código × columna of the ruta otherwise (case, accents and plurals aside), borrows its diccionario, or whose periodos reach before the ventana; such a year has no months. A manual meta, or one waiting for its ruta oficial, has none.
What a figure's source panel shows (docs/adr/0009): origen and fecha_corte, on the card for its mes and on each month of historico, say where that month comes from: «planilla del establecimiento», saved that day (YYYY-MM-DD), for a month its planilla covers (docs/adr/0010), else «datos públicos DEIS», cut at that year's load's last month (YYYY-MM). Each year of historico carries its ruta: the numerador's and the denominador's fuente, its nombre as GET fuentes serves it, periodo (desde, hasta: YYYY-MM, moved to that year) and the códigos to add (sumar) and subtract (restar), one list per consulta, each labelled for its columns by that year's diccionario as POST consultas labels it. A denominador of FONASA's inscritos is fuente piv, named, with no periodo and no códigos; one only a commitment gives is null.
meta_minima (Res. Exenta 732) is the lowest meta comprometida the meta's seed rule allows, a reference only: porcentaje, rounded half up to one decimal, from the cierre of base, the last year of historico that is over and whose December is published, and for Meta II that year's meta comprometida. motivo says why there is no porcentaje («esperando ruta oficial», «falta el denominador oficial de <año>», «no hay cierre comparable de <año>», «no hay cierre comparable» when the ventana holds no complete year), or why Meta II applies its stricter branch. A manual meta's is its fixed minimum, with no base. Null when the seed writes no rule. referencia cites the metas' resolución and OOTT.
The establishment is this install's (app config), unless the request names another DEIS code (suite ADR-0009). This install's is the stored Resumen, rebuilt in the background after each change it reads (docs/adr/0009), so every reader sees the same figures until the next; another establishment's is built on each request and never stored.
nota (CONTEXT.md) is what a model wrote about what changed at the last rebuild, from the figures alone, kept only when every number in it is one this Resumen shows or a year or month it names. Null when no text-generation provider is connected, until it answers, when its answer was dropped, and for another establishment.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: The admin section's actions: its writes, and the ingest state it reads. Every public method carries #[AuthorizedAdminSetting(settings: AdminSettings::class)] and nothing else that decides who may call it: NC core lets a real admin through, lets a member of any group an admin delegated the section to through, and answers 403 to everyone else (SecurityMiddleware). A hand-written admin check beside it would refuse every delegate — IntraVox's SettingsApiController does exactly that — so there is none, and MetadataTest fails a method without the attribute (docs/adr/0003). The check's name is not even written here: the a10 gate greps this directory for it. CSRF stays on: the section's own requests carry the token, and an API client sends OCS-APIRequest: true, which NC accepts in its place.

tags.name: api
tags.description: Estadística over OCS: the contract suite apps and M3 read (the contracts page on the documentation site, Slice 10). farmacia's resource-per-endpoint shape (the OCS decision), under Spanish resource names: fuentes, consultas, preguntas, tableros, indicadores and resumen. Consumers send `OCS-APIRequest: true`, which is also the CSRF protection (Request::passesCSRFCheck), and get the OCS envelope back: GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/estadistica/api/v1/fuentes { "ocs": { "meta": {…}, "data": [ …the fuentes… ] } } Everyone reads everything published (D6), so every route is #[NoAdminRequired], and every one carries a #[UserRateLimit] (MetadataTest holds both). Anyone may save a pregunta or a tablero; changing one is its creator's, or belongs to whoever administers Estadística, and SavedContent answers everyone else with a 403.
